sermon.title: The Glory of the Latter House 10/1/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer reviews the former house—the miraculous, righteous, unified early church, with fear after Ananias and Sapphira—then the falling away under Constantine and Theodosius, the restoration and times of refreshing, and the coming latter house that will reach all nations. He then teaches Isaiah 53:11–12: the travail of Jesus’ soul, his knowledge, the dividing of the spoil, and his intercession at God’s right hand.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “2,286 ad” said for Rome’s division (286 AD); “Deuteronomy 13 to 9” said for the Lord’s portion (Deuteronomy 32:9); Russia funding US groups; Supreme Court calling atheism a religion; Jewish vs. ~5% literacy; Southern Baptists founded on slavery; Luther drowning Baptists; four great awakenings; dates 313/380 AD. Sensitive content kept as spoken: communism/socialism/democratic socialism as the source of America’s division; corrupt popes “homosexuals ... committed adultery”, inquisition torture; Calvin “a horrible man”; healings after 1948 “became phony”; unbelieving Jews “gonna die in their sins and they're going to the lake of fire”; Jesus-only believers (“who is this birdbrain at the right hand of God”); liberal church that skips the virgin birth; neighbors thought he was nuts.
